origin.summary: Workout 4 of the 2016 CrossFit Open. The Open is the worldwide online qualifying stage of the CrossFit Games season: one workout released each week, completed and scored by hundreds of thousands of athletes in affiliates and garages on the same few days.

description: A 13-minute AMRAP of four movements all set to the same high rep count — 55 deadlifts, wall-ball shots, rowing calories, and handstand push-ups.
source_notes: games.crossfit.com/workouts/open/2016/4 (official CrossFit Games Open workout), retrieved 2026-07-09
